hal.name: IS_LPTIM_AUTORELOAD
hal.brief: 校验 LPTIM 自动重载值不超过 16 位最大值(0xFFFF)

params.name: __AUTORELOAD__
params.desc: 待校验的自动重载计数值

retval.desc: 校验通过返回 1, 否则返回 0

hal.name: IS_LPTIM_CLOCK_PRESCALER
hal.sig:
#define IS_LPTIM_CLOCK_PRESCALER(__PRESCALER__) (((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV1  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV2  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV4  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV8  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV16 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV32 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV64 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV128))
hal.brief: 校验 LPTIM 时钟预分频系数是否为 DIV1~DIV128 之一

retval.desc: 校验通过返回 1, 否则返回 0

hal.src:
#define IS_LPTIM_CLOCK_PRESCALER(__PRESCALER__) (((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV1  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV2  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV4  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV8  ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV16 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV32 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV64 ) || \
                                                 ((__PRESCALER__) ==  LPTIM_PRESCALER_DIV128))

ll.brief: 校验 LPTIM 寄存器更新模式是否为立即更新(LL_LPTIM_UPDATE_MODE_IMMEDIATE)或周期结束更新(LL_LPTIM_UPDATE_MODE_ENDOFPERIOD)
